column1: # Self-test cases whose whole point is an identifier OUTSIDE the reserve.
# They live here rather than inline in check_identifier_namespace.py for a
# reason the gate found on its own: the moment that script was committed it
# became tracked, the scanner read it like any other file, and it failed on its
# own test data. Ten hits, all of them examples.
# This directory is excluded from the scan by design -- it is the one place in
# the repo whose job is to hold values that must be caught. Keeping the failing
# literals anywhere else means either a gate that fails on itself or a gate that
# exempts a file it should be reading.
# Format, tab-separated: expected_in_reserve <TAB> expected_out <TAB> label <TAB> line
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

column3: a run of real pre-scrub companies reads every value, not just the first
an out-of-reserve company inside a run is caught beside the in-reserve ones
an unprovenanced 7-digit business unit is caught
the same account ending a sentence is still caught, not eaten by the dot
a low-series company in company position is caught
